component.name: TonePush
component.summary: Editor and tone library for Line 6 HX pedals and the StompStation PRO

description.p: An open-source editor for Line 6 HX-family devices and the Sonulab StompStation PRO, written in Rust.

Edit presets block by block, keep your tones in a library you can search, audition a tone on the pedal before you keep it, build setlists, and back up the pedal. TonePush is an independent project, not affiliated with Line 6, Yamaha or Sonulab.
On Linux, USB pedals need TonePush's access rule on the computer. The Flatpak cannot install it: the guide shows how to add it.
